t: Zinsser Cover Stain is a professional solvent-based paint primer and sealer designed to block tough stains on interior and exterior surfaces. This high-performance undercoat seals water, smoke, and nicotine damage, making it ideal for refurbishing high-traffic commercial spaces and residential properties. Decorators can apply this versatile primer to any surface without sanding first, saving time on site. The fast-drying formula is touch-dry in 35 minutes and ready to recoat in 2 hours. This white matt primer provides 9.8m²/Ltr of coverage.
b: Adhesion to any Surface without Sanding
